_comment: Locations. id is added to LOCATION_ID_BASE and never reused. source says how the game marks it done: an EventControl event plus the global flag it sets (see agent_docs/MEASURED.md). The client sends a check when that flag becomes true. source.give, where known, is the |giveitem,type,item,...| that hands out the vanilla item on that map (type 0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal): the client keeps it out of the inventory and shows the seed's item instead. Artifacts are events (no id): the game counts 7 artifact flags, and the goal is having enough of them.
